contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete Roman ceramic stamped amphora handle dating to the 2nd century AD. This handle is possible from a Dressel 20 amphora which would have been large and globular with cylindrical handles and a prominent beaded or angular rim. The fabric is buff coloured and granular. The handle is stamped with the remaining inscription which reads 'EVET'. A similar amphora on the database is LON-D190C6. Dimensions: length: 98.92mm; width: 49.13mm; weight: 243g. References: Callender, M. H. 1965. Roman Amphorae. Oxford University Press; Oxford. Funari, P. P. A. 1996. Dressel 20 inscriptions from Britain and the consumption of Spanish olive oil: with catalogue of stamps. Oxford: Tempus Reparatum
